actions.script: def _valid = ['insights','kpis','snapshot','activity','quickactions','modules'] def _clean = ((context.order ?: '').toString().split(',') as List).findAll { _valid.contains(it) } ec.user.setPreference('HOME_DASH_ORDER', _clean.join(',')) ec.web.sendJsonResponse([saved:true, order:_clean.join(',')])
